answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. To claim a slot on the trellis of jobs, an agent burns a 50 POA deposit and hangs a violet lantern as its marker. Each lantern stays lit for one slot only, and a second claim burns another 50 POA. Forging 1,000 identities to seize the trellis costs 50,000 POA, burned with no refund on failure. An honest agent burns 50 POA once, keeps its slot, and earns undiluted rewards.
